# Audo

> Senior technology partner for websites, web applications, automation, AI coaching, and product strategy.

Audo helps individuals and small businesses get practical technology work off their plate. Audo is Aaron Hancock's independent consulting practice, intentionally small so clients can work directly with one senior partner who understands the context, makes the fix, and can continue supporting the work without large-agency overhead.

Website: https://getaudo.com/
Discovery: https://getaudo.com/#discovery

## Services

- Website and web application management: ongoing care for existing websites, apps, forms, hosting, analytics, integrations, UX cleanup, and steady improvements.
- Website, app, dashboard, and internal tool creation: business websites, mobile apps, customer portals, internal admin tools, quote and estimate tools, dashboards, MVPs, prototypes, and supported launches.
- Automation consulting: help with repeat tasks, follow-up, scheduling, CRM integrations, reminders, reports, documents, spreadsheets, SOPs, and tool handoffs.
- AI coaching, training, and support: AI use cases, AI-powered website support agents, prompt coaching, team training, privacy rules, tool selection, and AI-assisted workflows.
- Product consulting and strategy: customer needs, product priorities, MVP scope, feasibility, build-vs-buy decisions, product due diligence, M&A technology review, and next steps.

## Service Library

The site includes a focused library of 49 service examples covering website and app care, automation, AI support, product strategy, and individual consulting. The homepage presents three animated, auto-rotating examples at a time, and each service page explains the problem, how Audo helps, the expected result, common questions, and includes a Free Discovery form that identifies the service in the request.

Service pages use clean URLs under https://getaudo.com/services/ and are listed in the dynamic sitemap.

## Why Audo

Audo gives individuals and small businesses senior tech help without the agency runaround. Clients do not need to know the exact problem before reaching out; Aaron can help discover what is slowing things down, explain the options clearly, and get the work handled without account layers, handoff chains, multiple vendors, or technical translation. Audo is Aaron Hancock's independent consulting practice, built for people who need a trusted technology partner. Aaron has spent 30 years solving technology problems, from building websites in high school to leading product and engineering teams across Cox Automotive, Dealertrack, and Dealer.com. Through prior roles, OEM programs, and agency work, he has also supported M&A, product due diligence, integrations, migrations, launches, and client work for organizations including John Maxwell Leadership Foundation, Hattori Hanzo, L'Oreal, and others.

## Client Work

- Boston's Pizza Restaurant & Sports Bar: ADA compliance, marketing site and CMS management, database and server management, and ongoing support.
- Carnac AI Trading: full platform build, creation of proprietary technical analysis tools, crypto exchange integrations, and AI market analysis system.

Aaron's AI point of view is practical and context-first. AI can save real time, but only when it understands the business context. Audo helps clients decide where AI fits, where it does not, and how to use it with privacy, review, and common sense.

For clients, that background means senior product, software, UX, automation, and AI judgment without account layers. The same person can diagnose, build, explain, and support the work.
